releaseNotes: Reworked verse study into a floating selected-verse overlay so study resources no longer push Scripture out of place. Added direct access to prayer, declarations, dictionary, commentary and theology, original-language study, cross-references, notes and the full Study Centre inside the overlay; word studies and YouVersion comparison are routed into the same experience. Expanded 27 core dictionary entries with language notes, theological significance, interpretive cautions and related Scripture references. The commentary panel is clearly identified as a context-led study framework until a complete source-attributed commentary library can be licensed and verified. The offline KJV remains the dependable base; online translations remain optional until the secure YouVersion Worker is deployed and authorised versions are verified.
